I had some progress on building dart version on windows. Here are some issues:
1. The later issue is because of https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/c7572ac1f9bbda59ba301dd330e6f64faf91b9e1/tools/build/dartdetect.js#L13. It should be dart.exe.
2. https://github.com/angular/ts2dart/issues/191
3. https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/c7572ac1f9bbda59ba301dd330e6f64faf91b9e1/tools/build/dartanalyzer.js#L27 should be `fileName = 'package:' + packageName + '/' + path.relative('lib', fileName).replace(/\\/g, "/");`
4. https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/c7572ac1f9bbda59ba301dd330e6f64faf91b9e1/tools/build/pubbuild.js#L51 should be `fs.renameSync(subFolder, subFolder.replace('/web/', '/'));` I don't know why the slashes are normalized here, but they are.

But I stuck at pubbuild step. I seems that angular dart transformer is not dealing with windows backslashes very well.

Nice to see that I'm not alone on this quest :) 
I had identified the first 2 issues too, for the same reasons.

A follow up of https://github.com/angular/ts2dart/issues/191 would be to normalize slashes in https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/tools/broccoli/broccoli-ts2dart.ts
Depending how `ts2dart` is fixed, it may concern lines 18, 34 and 47.
Thanks for the effort on this and sorry for my part in the trouble (I've been working on the angular 2 dart transformer). Is there a stack trace I can look at re: the pub build step?
